data.title: Kernel finite-closure check rejects undefined reads (definedness chain rule, independent of model-core)

data.body: Kernel review (GOV 4). Soundness: PASS. Line-by-line against model-core Definedness::of: subject/base/depth strip identical (non-empty rest, '#defined' as base gives base '#defined' depth 1 in both); walk visits member full name down to base in both; the three clauses (contains '(', not a declared predicate, action name or schema) match; chain_of set for a named base on both the well-formed and fail-closed branches; members sorted (Reverse(depth), index); action chains sorted by shallowest member. model.rs is_action_or_schema(name) is equivalent to model-core's action_names set for any name without '(' (an action has schema name iff it starts with name+'(' because name has no '('; the partition_point run is contiguous over the decoder's strictly ascending names), and names with '(' fail closed by the contains test in both. Independent probe: 20000 models with names drawn from tokens {I, A, #defined, (, ), k, #, (k=0), defined, #defined(} plus actions reusing chain names and name(k=1) schemas, 126024 claims plus the single-false sweep, kernel verdict equal to the model-core-derived verdict in every case (scratchpad kreview-iu8eh/probe).

Kernel review (GOV 4). Every table state is scanned; every action chain is evaluated at every state independent of guards or enabling, so never-enabled actions are covered. Subject None checks only action chains, which is correct (another predicate's chain does not bear on a state-domain claim). Precedence and skip structure match engine-reference definedness::scan (continue after an undefined action/subject read; subject evaluated only where its reads are defined). Precharge: evaluation_work adds sum of all definedness predicate sizes plus the claimed base's chain again per state, and classification_work, before step 1; that dominates action_guards + guards_of(subject). No indexing, no recursion, no panics in the new code; clippy clean. Scanning unreachable table states is correct under the claim semantics: the claim is about the carried S (closure and S subset of P), so an undefined read at any carried state voids it; the reference emitter carries only reachable states, so no false reject on its output.

Kernel review (GOV 4). LOW, documentation. The migration note names one retyping (earlier violation plus later overflow is now EvaluationOverflow). There is a second: an invariant false at an earlier table state and Fault::DepthExhausted at a later one was Rejected(InvariantViolated) and is now Unsupported (expression depth). That weakens a refutation to typed-inconclusive; it is not unsound and it matches the reference scan (an evaluation error ends it), but the note should say so. Non-blocking.

data.reason: Kernel review (GOV 4, second non-author reviewer). No claim over an undefined read verifies: the kernel classifier matches model-core Definedness::of clause for clause (independent 20000-model wild-name differential, 126024 claims, zero disagreements), every action chain is checked at every table state, precedence matches the reference scan, precharge covers classification and scan before step 1, no panic/unsafe/recursion, INV-004 boundaries clean. Ran: cargo test -p continuum-kernel-core (125 pass), kernel_definedness_differential, c018_checker_mutation, check_kernel_covenant.py (pass), check_crate_boundaries.py (pass), clippy -D warnings. One LOW doc gap (th-flfuv5): migration note omits the DepthExhausted retyping to Unsupported. Non-blocking.

data.body: [INFO][risk:high] Failure modes: false Verified from misclassified definedness chains or wrong precedence; fail-closed classification at definedness.rs:167-218 and the ordered scan here prevent it. Edge cases: chain gaps, missing bases, action and schema collisions, nested guards, false guard subjects, unreachable carried states, and later evaluation faults were traced. Rollback: revert 7c0b0deb59fd980126d2b4bd6187057bf3ab34b4; this restores the prior gap and requires revalidation, with no wire migration. Monitoring: count undefined-action-read, undefined-invariant-read, evaluation-overflow, and evaluation-work resource-bound verdicts at the kernel boundary. Validation: reviewed all 32 changed files and traced wire decode through precharge, classification, state scan, verdict tokens, daemon vocabulary, differential cases, mutation ledger, and governance evidence. No security finding. This reviewer contract prevented test execution.

data.reason: Exact-range security review complete at 7c0b0deb59fd980126d2b4bd6187057bf3ab34b4. No security blocker. The independent classifier fails closed, the complete definedness scan is precharged, and verdict propagation is closed over both new rejection reasons. Static review only under the reviewer contract. Any risk:critical human approval remains separate.
